verdict.rationale: Decagon's own docs say agents get real-time access to customer systems through scoped JWT tokens, retrieve data through no-code integrations, and carry conversation history across sessions. This shows answers can draw on live customer data rather than only help articles. However, the docs never name plan, order status or account-history lookups, and no independent or hands-on corroboration exists, so this is partial rather than full coverage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of plan, order-status and account-history retrieval during answers, and independent or hands-on evidence that responses are actually personalized with live data.

support.subject: As a support leader, answers use the customer's live data — plan, order status, account history — not just generic help articles

citations.quote: Short-lived JWT tokens give AI agents real-time access to customer systems, scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session.
They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
Carry conversation history across sessions to pick up where you left off and make proactive recommendations based on customer signals.
Maintain customer context across sessions, complementing your systems of record with data portability and control.
lets your Decagon agent access and complete tasks inside systems where there isn’t a traditional integration available
